bounds_and_performance_risks.evidence: Frozen baseline already consumed 97.725895 CPU and 217.32050153892487 wall seconds; this leaves about 82.27 CPU and 142.68 wall seconds under the 180/360 contract, not a measured guarantee.
bounds_and_performance_risks.risk: New full source fixtures, two separate connected router builds (INT09 and INT10), 64 branch runs, report controls, bundle copying and repeated F11 verification may exceed remaining headroom.

bounds_and_performance_risks.evidence: Each predict_complete_bracket head reads commit once, accessor.__call__ reopens (restore plus another read), predict reopens again and reads again, and serve_bound_model reads again. Every SemanticArtifactStore.read_commit runs _check_accounting/storage_accounting over retained store files and revalidates closure. Three heads multiply this per action; four contacts at the nonflat cut across learned branches/policies/scenarios yield hundreds of head reads.
bounds_and_performance_risks.risk: Repeated complete store scans, hashing and closure attestation dominate small synthetic numerical fits. Consolidate only within exact immutable operation scope, never weaken public F11 revalidation or create a mutable cross-call cache.

bounds_and_performance_risks.evidence: Bundle F03 invokes all-model _validate on export, load, and e0-check; each reopens all distinct per-head fitted models. It also copies all six actual stores with publish_new/fsync and verifies every copied byte.
bounds_and_performance_risks.risk: At least three full retained-model sweeps plus store export wall cost are newly added to the shared worker. Eliminate only redundant helper passes where the required public port remains asserted.

bounds_and_performance_risks.evidence: e0_feature_values reconstructs native VenuePath for each contacted side; runner builds each day population independently for every one of 64 sessions and retains all full reports in memory. Bundle allows up to 256 MiB bytes/500000 typed nodes, while E0 manifest permits 57600 cuts and 160 days.
bounds_and_performance_risks.risk: Finite bounds do not establish practical full-cohort runtime/memory at those maxima. Tiny registered engineering fixtures can be supported without claiming full-scale throughput.

defects.impact: Published matrix/cache/trial identities can claim different source/fold bytes from those actually consumed. The bundle boundary verifies these bindings, but the public direct API used by INT10 bypasses that verifier.
defects.static_trigger: replace a valid manifest source_hashes with an arbitrary nonempty tuple, or fold_version with another nonempty value, while keeping day_versions and router.version. validate_run_inputs and E0ReplaySession accept this declaration. The direct matrix entry point then registers and executes it.
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Move the cheap actual six-input and router-fold digest checks into a shared public preflight used by both matrix and bundle; retain actual code-snapshot verification at the retained-byte boundary. Keep generic checkpoint hash controls explicitly separate.
defects.title: Direct runner does not verify actual input/fold commitments

defects.impact: The E0 adapter does not establish its claimed exact daily grouping; downstream OOF validates supplied group identities rather than reconstructing the business date.
defects.static_trigger: A Sample with date_group 2022-01-01 and decision_at on 2022-06-01 satisfies the current year/date-group test. Multiple false date_group strings within one year can split observations from the same physical trading day.
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Require date_group to equal the declared E0 business date derived from decision_at in America/New_York, while keeping arbitrary-group generic Fold APIs separate. Add a same-physical-day/mismatched-date negative inside INT09-F01.
defects.title: Calendar date groups are checked only by year

defects.impact: OS limits cap the process but do not establish strict terminal resource acceptance, nor complete worker CPU accounting. This diverges from the reviewed ORCH-03/06 resource semantics when those limits are claimed for this CLI.
defects.static_trigger: _run marks success solely from exit_code == 0. It retains wait4 CPU/RSS/wall but never rejects measurements equal to or above 180 CPU, 4 GiB, or 360 wall. run_e0_matrix tests elapsed CPU with >180, not the strict accepted boundary, and its measurement begins after bundle loading. e0-report returns the inner matrix measurement rather than supervisor physical telemetry.
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Validate finite, correctly typed actual wait4 observations against strict terminal bounds before reporting success; join supervisor and inner attempt receipts, preserving inner timing separately. Add structural/finalizer controls inside the authorized group; do not run a second matrix.
defects.title: CLI final success does not enforce strict observed resource limits

defects.impact: The exact frozen case can pass while omitting an explicitly required comparison. The four INT10 branches do not substitute for these separately named controls.
defects.static_trigger: INT09-F03 expected.baseline_rows is [always_flat, simple_time, simple_range]. Neither test nor helper references simple_time, simple_range, or baseline_rows, and no result from this slice emits these controls.
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Produce and assert the registered baseline rows using their declared definitions, or have root resolve the explicit source disposition without silently weakening the golden.
defects.title: Frozen simple time and simple range baseline rows are absent

defects.impact: E0_REFERENCE_EXPERIMENT acceptance requires labels and no-contact/censor counts with complete decision sets. Retaining candidate rows alone does not label rejected/untraded opportunities.
defects.static_trigger: The returned report contains decision_sets, decisions and executed bracket outcomes, but no object/path label population, no-contact count or censor count. literal_projection tests fills and account metrics and cannot detect this absence.
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Join a separately matured, fixed-end label inventory to the retained population/report without making it available to action selection; verify its denominator and uncertainty counts. If already owned by a separate report artifact, explicitly link that artifact and scope the runner report claim.
defects.title: Runner report omits complete future label coverage for retained candidates

defects.impact: The failed/interrupted execution remains attributable through started/PID files, but the stated durable finalization/recovery semantics are incomplete for parent death. This does not affect the separate engineering_batch supervisor recovery implementation.
defects.static_trigger: After supervision-start and supervision-launched are retained, killing the parent leaves the bounded worker to exit later; there is no e0 recovery command to observe/charge its usage or finish a running inner TrialRegistry attempt. Reusing e0-run on the output root is forbidden by mkdir(exist_ok=False).
defects.suggested_consolidated_repair: Reuse the established lifecycle/recovery mechanism or add a no-new-worker finalizer with conservative reservation charging when usage is unavailable.
defects.title: CLI interrupted lifecycle has no recovery finalizer when supervisor dies

positive_contract_disposition: The three learning groups and three runner groups are public registered methods; helper files introduce no additional public test groups.

F11 reads are actual SemanticArtifactStore/ReadSession/serve_bound_model calls; restore revalidates fitted metadata, source payloads, folds, upstream calibration route and target bytes. No synthetic expected coefficient is substituted for a fitted model.
Connected router requires both policies and target/stop/deadline heads; actual committed predictions are normalized with exact Fractions under a separately named normalization.
Evaluation outcomes are retained but excluded from fit/selection/calibration; the evaluation-label-flip invariant is asserted. Selection labels crossing its stage boundary are rejected.

Bundle codec uses an explicit whitelist, exact dataclass field schema and enum registry including Band/Unit, no input-directed imports/pickle/eval; the final nested manifest/day/router object types were checked statically against constructors.

Bundle verifies inventory regular files, relative paths/symlinks, per-file/aggregate/node/depth/file-count bounds, six retained input byte hashes and exact current source snapshot; reconstructed models reopen from copied actual F11 stores.

F03 bundle helper checks real export/load/check plus a held-out retained calibrated prediction and changed day hash, unknown field, traversal, native/code-byte rejection. It does not exercise e0-run or e0-report.

Restart binds an actual retained checkpoint hash to durable journals and separately reconciles pending authorization/entry/closed-day inventory. Generic checkpoint tests are explicitly separated from the real account restart.

CLI uses one fresh child per new root, hard OS limits before loading bundle/matrix, actual wait4 usage, killed-child cleanup, and retains worker stdout plus start/PID/final supervision records. No additional matrix execution was introduced into tests.
scope: Final consolidated static source/code/test review of learning, retained serving, runner, bundle and CLI slice
